issues.text: Section 4 no longer uses 'kind', and the prose gloss ('kind, the tool that created the cluster') now sits right after the first block. But reading in order I still meet 'kind' first in this code comment, where 'which kind passes on' reads like 'which kind (of domains)'. The gloss arrives a few lines later and settles it, so I only paused.
issues.fix: Move the gloss earlier, into the prose before the first block, e.g. end its first sentence with '…in the cluster that kind, the tool that created it, runs'; the awk sentence can then say just 'through kind'.
